# SettingsPage

The Services module page: connect streaming services, manage API keys, set appearance and move your data in and out.

`SongNodes.SettingsPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SettingsPage titleLead="…" title="…" connections={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SettingsPage" title-lead="…" title="…" connections="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `titleLead` * | `string` | Lead of the thin–bold title, normally the module label. |

| `drawerCounts` | `Partial<Record<ModuleKey, [number, string, StatusKey?]>>` | Drawer counts and attention badges: { pipeline: [2, "scrapers paused", "warn"] }. |
